export_mechanism: Web portal (https://patientdata.mdronline.net) - practice login, select patients, click 'Export EHR'
documentation_source: MDRhythm B10 Data Export Instructions.pdf (3 pages)
sample_data_format: Screenshot of PDF export in B10 instructions document

fields.name: Patient Name
fields.description: Patient's full name (visible in sample export header)

entities.notes: Only name, sex, and DOB visible in sample. No address, contact, insurance, or other demographic fields documented.
entities.source: B10 PDF page 2 sample export screenshot

fields.name: Allergy
fields.description: Name of allergen (e.g., 'Amoxicillin, Apples, Beer, Shampoo' in sample)

entities.notes: Sample shows allergen names only as a comma-separated list. No severity, reaction type, onset date, or status fields visible.
entities.source: B10 PDF page 2 sample export screenshot

entities.notes: Sample shows a table with columns: Medication, SIG/Directions, Supply, Count, Refills, Date, Status. Separate section for 'Medication by Others' with same columns.
entities.source: B10 PDF page 2-3 sample export screenshot

fields.name: Medical History
fields.description: List of medical history items with dates

fields.name: Diagnosis Codes
fields.description: Diagnosis codes with descriptions in the Assessment section

entities.notes: Sample shows Medical History as a list (e.g. 'Acute and subacute liver necrosis', 'Anxiety started 1/27/2016 test 1') and Diagnosis Codes in Assessment with ICD codes and descriptions.
entities.source: B10 PDF page 2 sample export screenshot

fields.name: Provider Name
fields.description: Name of provider for the visit

fields.name: Plan of Care
fields.description: Care plan items (e.g., nutrition, exercise, dietary management)

fields.name: Electronic Signature
fields.description: Electronically signed by provider name and timestamp

entities.notes: Each visit note appears with SOAP structure. Sample shows provider 'Max Burger, MD', visit date 11/07/2022. Includes diagnosis codes, procedure codes, diagnostic tests, and plan of care within the note.
entities.source: B10 PDF page 2-3 sample export screenshot

entities.notes: Sample shows: 'BP: 130/76 mmHg L Arm Sitting, Respiration: 14 Unlabored, Temperature: 98.4 °F, Pulse: 98 Regular /min, Height: 5-9.0" (46%), Weight: 160 Lbs, BMI: 23.63 (70%)'
entities.source: B10 PDF page 2 sample export screenshot

b10_documented_categories: Current Medication Details and Medication History
notes: The B10 export is a PDF file, not structured/machine-readable data.
No data dictionary is provided - only a 3-page PDF with instructions and one sample export screenshot.
The export covers 6 clinical data categories only.
No billing, insurance, scheduling, pharmacy/inventory, document management, or administrative data is included.
The FHIR API (g)(10) covers 20 USCDI resource types - all clinical, no billing or operational data.
The B10 export appears to be a subset of what's available via the FHIR API, rendered as PDF.
